content.short: Rocko is a non-custodial DeFi loan marketplace where borrowers compare rates and quickly access loans from popular protocols.
content.description: Rocko is a non-custodial platform that helps borrowers compare interest rates and quickly obtain loans from popular DeFi protocols such as Compound and Aave. Built for everyday crypto users, Rocko also supports accounts at major centralized exchanges, enabling borrowers to use their existing Coinbase or Binance accounts for the loan. The platform provides a comprehensive loan dashboard to monitor metrics, carry out transactions, and set up email or SMS alerts for collateral value and interest-rate changes.
